utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's still early days. I hope we have a solid schedule soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, if you need a hand organizing anything or spreading the word, I'm happy to help when I'm out and about.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, did you say something about a repair drive? I hope it's not going to take too long.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, just a quick fix. Should be done by noon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Noon sounds fine — I've got errands to run, so I'll be out of your hair anyway.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going to help that guy with his broken fence? I thought he was bluffing about fixing it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure we have the right tools for that job. Have you checked if he even has the materials?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean he hasn't even bought the wood yet? So we're just supposed to guess what he needs?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Cleo! I heard something about a repair drive—remind me what that's all about again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to collect and repair broken items—tools, electronics, furniture—so we can reuse them instead of tossing them out. I'm helping coordinate the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, that's a great idea! I think I have an old toaster somewhere in my garage I could dig up for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, what exactly are we fixing in the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand the plan before jumping in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think we're mostly focusing on fixing up the old playground equipment in the park—did you see that broken swing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I did notice the broken swing—it’s been like that for weeks. Is there a checklist of other things to repair, or just that one piece for now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late. What's this about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all! I was just thinking we could pool our tools and help the Johnsons fix that fence before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can bring my hammer and some nails—just tell me when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you're organizing that repair drive. Let me know what tools you need—I've got a whole shed full.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's great, Sam! We could really use a good set of wrenches and a power drill if you've got one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got both—wrenches and a power drill. I'll bring them over Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive? Where exactly is it happening this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at the community center on Oak Street, starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The community center on Oak Street? I'll make a note of that — can't have anyone showing up at the wrong location again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, did you hear about the repair drive they're organizing this Saturday at the community center? I think they're looking for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I already grabbed a flyer this morning! I was about to start knocking on doors to rally the neighbors. Are you planning to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I'm in! I've got some spare time and I'd love to help patch up the old playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, you got a minute? I wanted to ask about that repair drive you mentioned yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh hey, Mina. Yeah, sure, what did you want to know about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is it really going to be next Saturday? I need to plan my weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, are you going to the repair drive this weekend? I heard it's going to be a big one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've heard a little about it—what exactly is being repaired?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think they're fixing up all sorts of things—old bikes, appliances, even some furniture. Folks are bringing stuff from all over the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Uli! I'm glad you're interested in the repair drive. We're planning it for next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Next Saturday, you say? I'll have to check if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Take your time, no rush! We're also looking for people to bring tools or extra supplies if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing down on Maple Street? I heard they're collecting old tools and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I did hear a bit about that. I was planning to drop off my old lawnmower, but I want to make sure I know the exact time they're accepting donations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think it's this Saturday from 9 to 3, but let me double-check with Mrs. Patterson—she's the one running it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late—what's the plan for the repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane! We're meeting at my place at 10, then heading over to fix Mrs. Chen's fence—don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, 10 at your place—I'll grab my toolbox. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Uli, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, it's just a small neighborhood thing—we're collecting old tools and spare parts to fix up some things around here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds practical. What kind of things are you hoping to fix?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? When's that again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's on the second Saturday of next month. I already marked it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, second Saturday. I'll pencil it in, though I'll probably need a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood—sounds like a great way to bring everyone together!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Jules! Yes, I'm planning it. Did you have any specific items or skills in mind that you'd like to contribute?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm pretty handy with small electronics and furniture assembly—I'd be happy to help fix things or even teach a few basics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I heard something about that... when was it again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. I'll be there helping out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, got it. I’ll try to swing by, but I might be a bit late—I’ve got a thing in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the community center tools. Need a hand picking up donations?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, that'd be great! I've got a list of folks who said they'd donate, and I could use some company hauling stuff.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, I've got my truck free this afternoon — just point me to the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a set of tools I can lend if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, that'd help. What kind of tools you got?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got a full socket set, screwdrivers, wrenches, and a drill with bits—should cover most basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm a bit worried about the timing—will we have enough people to handle everything efficiently?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people have signed up so far? Let's see if we need to recruit more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Only about five so far, and that's not nearly enough to cover all the tasks we planned.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! Did you hear we're organizing a neighborhood repair drive? I'm helping spread the word—think you'd want to join?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds like a great idea! I've got a toolbox full of stuff I could bring—what kind of things are people planning to fix?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, all sorts of things! Furniture, electronics, clothing—even a few folks want to fix up their old bicycles. It's going to be a busy day!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I need to check the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, yes, the repair drive! I think I vaguely remember talking about that. What did we need to fix again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, you don’t remember? We were going to help fix up the old playground benches at the school park. The kids have been talking about it all week.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell! So glad you could make it to the repair drive. Have you had a chance to look over the list of items we're collecting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't yet—I've been catching up on neighborhood news through bits and pieces. Could you fill me in on what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course! We're focusing on fixing up old appliances and electronics this time—things like toasters, lamps, and even small computers. Got anything lying around that might fit the bill?
